[nvda:PurchasesOfPropertyAndEquipmentAndIntangibleAssets] Filer-specific synonym for capex on the investing-activities face. NVDA uses this branded extension in the 10-K (annual) in lieu of us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, which it uses in the 10-Q (interim). Single-tag regime: the row carries whichever candidate build_kb observed per period (us-gaap tag for interim quarters, the nvda extension for FY annual), so a single-tag formula preserving the observed value is correct and avoids the multi-tag extension xbrl_not_yet_supported path. (issue 006)
